info.name: ChatGPT - Hacker Green | Dark
info.description:
Transform ChatGPT into a neon-green hacker terminal with a dark, embedded
matrix-rain wallpaper and frosted-glass interface. Menus, navigation,
chat history, input composer, suggestion tiles, popovers and message panels
use translucent forest-green surfaces with neon outlines. Text adopts a
monospaced terminal aesthetic, while the ChatGPT logo and send button glow
green. The stylesheet includes support for newer 2026 --color-* and
older ChatGPT design tokens to cover more of the current interface.
